title: A House for God
reflectionQuestion: Solomon spent seven years building the most beautiful house he could, to thank God. I wonder what beautiful thing you could make or do to show God how thankful you are?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (Solomon category, 1 Kings 6-8). Pairs with 1882 Solomon's Wisdom. HAS A LONG -- earned through dramatic/scenic progression (David's longing + handoff -> the deal with King Hiram for cedar -> thousands of workers -> the wonder-detail that no hammer/tool was heard at the site -> the carvings + gold + pillars + golden angels -> 7 years -> the great dedication -> ark carried in -> the cloud of glory fills the house -> Solomon's kneeling prayer -> the feast), NOT padding. Room = giving God our best / gratitude + worship / God's presence comes to dwell with his people. Wonder + thankfulness, not a building-instructions list. Soft close ('him'). VOICE_JAMES_BRITISH_PROFESSIONAL (ear-verified male; stately, grand register fits the temple).
